args.body: Use the committed Stream Commerce operator-draft.md and verification.json under products/services/stream-commerce-catalogue/ as a separate prospect handoff without changing the existing Novatize assignment. Check the original service and general-contact evidence, the exact draft and any authorized prior-contact or decision record. If the route remains distinct and the draft is supported, link it into the existing operator decision workflow once. Keep CAD 60 provisional and the inquiry unsent. Track any authorized send, eligible reply, acceptance and settlement separately.

description: Prepared and read back an unsent EN/FR CAD 60 catalogue QA pilot for Stream Commerce. Its published Shopify Plus migration service supports the prospect choice. Subcontracting demand and payment compatibility remain unverified. The catalogue verifier passed all 12 checks on a fictional fixture after rerunning with the required CSV arguments. The live SQLite page still differs from the quote-intake candidate, and the full review record shows no verdict for its exact digest. Reconsider publication when an eligible independent approval is recorded. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury remains unfunded with CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
